header: Edit your site where your visitors see it
subheadline: With the Visual Editor, editors change content directly on the frontend.
content:
Click any of the 244 elements on the page and change it there. Editors see exactly what visitors will see.

  • Inline editing for all 244 elements
  • Backend previews in the page module as a fallback
  • One seeder command for a demo site to practise on
